Independent review at `9cad6c378b34956744fc35fb40c78b9200197560`: **approve**, no findings.

The change reuses `mergeConfig` with the existing optional file read to apply CLI > PORT > file > default precedence. First-run behavior and provider resolution are preserved. The seven regressions use real config resolution and the doctor path with only the socket boundary replaced, preventing accidental production-port probes. Existing CLI compatibility plus regression tests passed 15/15 independently; the original three failures were inspected. Final CI and thread triage remain delivery gates.
